boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free, public cultural and outdoor activities in Manhattan, with access details verified from official institutions and agencies.

cards.entity_name: Polonsky Exhibition of The New York Public Library's Treasures
cards.title: Browse NYPL's Treasures
cards.subtitle: Gottesman Hall, Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
cards.notes: Meet at Gottesman Hall and move through the permanent display together; leave time to compare one object each before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A free permanent exhibition of collection highlights spanning 4,000 years.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL identifies the Polonsky Exhibition as an ongoing, free exhibition at the Stephen A. Schwarzman Building.
cards.source_title: Polonsky Exhibition of The New York Public Library's Treasures
cards.access_notes: Free exhibition; check the page for temporary exhibition closures and building-entry timing.

cards.title: Take the NYPL building tour
cards.subtitle: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building Visitor Center
cards.notes: Reserve a spot for the one-hour docent tour, then meet in the Visitor Center at the listed start time for a shared look at the building.
cards.short_summary: A free, docent-led introduction to NYPL architecture, history, and collections.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL offers free one-hour building tours Monday through Saturday at 11 AM and 2 PM; tickets are required.
cards.access_notes: Free, but limited to the first 20 people who reserve online; meet in the Visitor Center.

cards.title: See the Rose Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
cards.notes: Arrive early for the weekday visiting hour and take in the reading room from the designated visitor access window; research seating is separate.
cards.short_summary: A historic reading room with a free daily visitor-access period.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL states that visitors may see the Rose Main Reading Room during free visiting hour, 10–11 AM Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Free visiting hour runs 10–11 AM Monday–Saturday; final entry is 10:50 AM.

cards.entity_name: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building Rooftop Terrace
cards.title: Pause on NYPL's rooftop terrace
cards.subtitle: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
cards.notes: Use the building’s public terrace as a low-key stop between classes; follow posted building rules and confirm any same-day access changes before going.
cards.short_summary: A publicly accessible rooftop terrace at NYPL's flagship building.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL says visitors may use the Stephen A. Schwarzman Building's free publicly accessible rooftop terrace.
cards.source_title: About the Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
cards.access_notes: The terrace is publicly accessible; enter during building hours and follow current library access rules.

cards.title: Explore Federal Hall's galleries
cards.subtitle: 15 Pine Street entrance, Financial District
cards.notes: Walk through the exhibit galleries at your own pace, then stop outside for the George Washington statue and the historic Wall Street façade.
cards.short_summary: A fee-free national memorial with exhibit galleries and self-guided access.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service says admission to Federal Hall National Memorial is free and self-guided visits do not require reservations.
cards.source_title: Fees and Passes - Federal Hall National Memorial
cards.access_notes: No entrance pass is required; confirm current opening status before traveling.

cards.title: Join a Federal Hall ranger tour
cards.subtitle: Federal Hall National Memorial, 15 Pine Street
cards.notes: Join the ranger for the scheduled one-hour orientation, then use the remaining time to revisit the exhibit that caught your group’s attention.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, free ranger-led tour of Federal Hall National Memorial.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS lists the Ranger-Guided Tour of Federal Hall as free; reservations are recommended but walk-ins are welcome.
cards.access_notes: Free; scheduled at 10:30 AM on listed days through 2027. Reservations are recommended, not required.

cards.entity_name: Writers Workshop at Bryant Park Reading Room
cards.title: Write outdoors at Bryant Park
cards.subtitle: Reading Room, Bryant Park
cards.notes: Bring a notebook and join the outdoor workshop, then stay afterward to swap a favorite prompt or a few lines with friends.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor writing workshop in Bryant Park's Reading Room.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists the Writers Workshop at Bryant Park Reading Room as a free summer writing workshop.
cards.access_notes: Listed as free by NYC Parks; check the official calendar for the scheduled date and weather updates.

cards.entity_name: Nature Talks at Bryant Park Reading Room
cards.title: Catch a Nature Talk
cards.subtitle: Reading Room, Bryant Park
cards.notes: Meet at the Reading Room for the outdoor lecture, then take a lap through the park and discuss one new idea from the speaker.
cards.short_summary: Free, outdoor nature lectures led by local experts.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists Nature Talks at Bryant Park Reading Room as free outdoor lectures led by local experts.
cards.access_notes: Listed as free by NYC Parks; verify the particular lecture's date, time, and weather status.

cards.title: Talk movies at Reel Talks
cards.subtitle: Reading Room, Bryant Park
cards.notes: Use the film conversation as a ready-made group plan: arrive a few minutes early, listen in, and compare takeaways after the discussion.
cards.short_summary: A free Bryant Park conversation series focused on movies and filmmaking.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists Reel Talks at Bryant Park as free talks on movies, cinema culture, and filmmaking.
cards.access_notes: Listed as free by NYC Parks; consult the calendar for the specific talk's schedule.

cards.title: Hear an author conversation
cards.subtitle: Reading Room, Bryant Park
cards.notes: Pick a listed Author Series session, meet at the Reading Room, and bring one question or theme to unpack together afterward.
cards.short_summary: A free Bryant Park program featuring author discussions and advice.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists Bryant Park Author Series events at the Reading Room as free.
cards.access_notes: Listed as free by NYC Parks; dates and featured speakers vary, so confirm the calendar entry.
